reason: Both sell to US employers and touch benefits administration. Paylocity is a unified HCM/payroll software platform (payroll, HR, tax filing, finance and IT). HealthEquity is an HSA/FSA/HRA/COBRA account custodian and benefits administrator. The products overlap only at the edge (benefits administration). Customers overlap (employers), but HealthEquity also sells to health plans and individual account holders. Both earn some float or interest income, but HealthEquity's fees come mainly from account custody and transactions, not software subscriptions.
